description: Shadow magic - creeping damage over time and the mind as a weapon.

nodes.name: Spirit Tap
nodes.description: A killing blow floods you with Spirit for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Gives you a 33%-100% chance to gain a 100% bonus to your Spirit after killing a target that yields experience or honor.' Built with the real chance curve on the real trigger. Doubling Spirit is not expressible from a proc payload - spirit inside status stat_mods is FLAT - so +40 stands in. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree, which had it at 5 ranks with flat spirit on the node itself. It is Improved Spirit Tap's prerequisite, preserved below.

nodes.name: Improved Spirit Tap
nodes.description: Increases your Spirit by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0, NEW to our tree: 'Your Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death critical strikes have a 100% chance and your Mind Flay critical strikes have a 50% chance to increase your Spirit by 5%/10% for 8 sec.' DEPARTURE - the real talent needs per-ability crit triggers with different chances, and on_crit cannot be split that way. Delivered as a permanent Spirit increase at the real magnitude. spirit_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS. The real talent requires Spirit Tap, which connected_to reproduces, and it feeds Twisted Faith at tier 5.

nodes.name: Darkness
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow spell damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0, built verbatim: 'Increases your Shadow spell damage by 2%-10%.' USES THE PER-SCHOOL KEY DELIBERATELY. shadow_spell_damage is built as f'{school}_spell_damage' at abilities.py:1371, so a literal grep cannot see it - this is the exact family that led to arcane_spell_damage being WRONGLY declared dead in this project, published in a commit and a project doc before correction. It is LIVE, and it is the right key for a school-scoped damage talent. The outgoing version used the school-agnostic spell_damage, which also lifted the priest's Holy damage.

nodes.name: Shadow Affinity
nodes.description: Reduces the threat you generate by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by 8%-25%, and you receive 15% of your base mana when your Shadow Word: Pain is dispelled.' The threat half is built - there is no per-school threat key. There is no dispel trigger either. The outgoing version granted flat shadow_resistance, which is a defensive stat and not this talent.

nodes.name: Improved Psychic Scream
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 2/4 sec.' Built verbatim as cooldown; the outgoing version increased its DURATION instead. It is Silence's prerequisite, preserved below.

nodes.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Shadow Word: Pain by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the damage of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 3%/6%.' Built verbatim over the real 2 ranks; the outgoing version had 5 ranks of 5%, reaching 25%.

nodes.name: Improved Mind Blast
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 0.5-2.5 sec.' Built as cooldown, which is what the real talent does - 2.5 seconds is roughly 1 turn, and talented_cooldown clamps the result at 1 so five ranks cannot drive it to zero. The outgoing version increased Mind Blast's damage, which is Twisted Faith's clause.

nodes.name: Shadow Focus
nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit by 1% per rank and reduces the cost of your Mind spells by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built with both halves: 'Increases your chance to hit with your Shadow spells by 1%/2%/3%, and reduces the mana cost of your Shadow spells by 2%/4%/6%.' hit_rating is PERCENTAGE POINTS and is NOT a valid STAT_CONVERSION_TARGET. Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 5 ranks to the real 3.

nodes.name: Mind Flay
nodes.description: Teaches Mind Flay, assaulting the target's mind with Shadow energy.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, kept - the ONLY unlock for priest_mind_flay, which is requires_talent. Moved from tier 3 to its real row, which matters because four later talents in this tree modify Mind Flay.

nodes.name: Silence
nodes.description: Teaches Silence, stilling an enemy's voice.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, kept - the ONLY unlock for priest_silence, which is requires_talent. The real talent requires Improved Psychic Scream, which connected_to reproduces. Note the ENGINE has no silence key - the ability itself is where that is modelled, and there is nothing for a talent to add.

nodes.name: Veiled Shadows
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Fade by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree: 'Decreases the cooldown of your Fade ability by 3/6 sec, and reduces the cooldown of your Shadowfiend ability by 1/2 minutes.' Shadowfiend does not exist. 6 seconds is 2 turns over 2 ranks.

nodes.name: Vampiric Embrace
nodes.description: Your Shadow damage heals you for a fifth of what it deals.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Fills you with the embrace of Shadow energy, causing you to be healed for 15% and other party members to be healed for 3% of any Shadow spell damage you deal.' Built with leech_pct, which is one of only THREE payloads that read the triggering hit's amount (the others being bonus_pct and smart heals) - so this is one of the few talents in the project that can scale off damage dealt. The party clause is dropped: a talent effect can never reach an ally. 20% against the real 15% compensates for losing that half. It is Improved Vampiric Embrace's and Shadowform's prerequisite, both preserved. The outgoing version granted max_health_pct.

nodes.name: Improved Vampiric Embrace
nodes.description: Increases the healing you receive by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree: 'Increases the healing received from Vampiric Embrace by 33%/67%.' DEPARTURE - nothing modifies a PROC's payload magnitude from outside it, so the leech cannot be scaled by another talent. Delivered as healing received, which lifts the leech along with everything else. The real talent requires Vampiric Embrace, reproduced.

nodes.name: Shadow Weaving
nodes.description: Your Shadow damage weaves itself stronger, increasing Shadow damage by 10% for 4 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Your Shadow damage spells have a 33%-100% chance to increase the Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.' STACKING IS NOT BUILDABLE - max_stacks exists on StatusEffect but NOTHING in this engine reads a stack count, so a 5-stack effect is indistinguishable from a 1-stack one. Built as a single application at the FULL stacked value (5 x 2% = 10%), which reaches the same ceiling without the ramp. The real chance curve is kept. 15 seconds is 4 turns. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Focused Mind
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your Mind Blast, Mind Flay and Mind Sear by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Reduces the mana cost of your Mind Blast, Mind Control, Mind Flay and Mind Sear spells by 5%/10%/15%.' Built verbatim for the three that exist. Kept from the outgoing tree, which used the FLAT _cost key on two of them.

nodes.name: Mind Melt
nodes.description: Increases the critical chance of your Mind spells by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, NEW to our tree: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Mind Blast, Mind Flay and Mind Sear spells by 2%/4%, and increases the periodic damage of Mind Flay.' The crit half is built verbatim across all three real abilities. ability_<id>_crit is PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Improved Devouring Plague
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Shadow Word: Pain and Mind Sear by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Increases the periodic damage done by your Devouring Plague by 5%/10%/15%, and when you cast Devouring Plague you instantly deal damage equal to 10%/20%/30% of its total periodic effect.' DEPARTURE - Devouring Plague does not exist. Its role here is Shadow Word: Pain (the maintained Shadow dot) and Mind Sear (the AoE), so the periodic half lands on both. The instant-damage clause cannot be built - nothing front-loads a dot. Kept from the outgoing tree, which was a 1-point proc on Mind Sear.

nodes.name: Improved Shadowform
nodes.description: While in Shadowform, reduces the cooldown of your Fade by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Your Fade ability now has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when used while in Shadowform, and reduces the cooldown of your Fade.' BUILT WITH THE REAL FORM CONDITION - shadowform is a real form id here and three existing talents in the project already gate on it, so require_form works. Movement impairment does not exist. The real talent requires Shadowform, which connected_to reproduces via the unlock node below.

nodes.name: Shadowform
nodes.description: Teaches Shadowform, wrapping you in Shadow.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, kept - the ONLY unlock for priest_shadowform, which is requires_talent. The real talent requires Vampiric Embrace, which connected_to reproduces. Moved from tier 2 to its real row. It is Vampiric Touch's prerequisite, preserved below.

nodes.name: Shadow Power
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Standardised 6 Nov: every caster tree carries one 5-point spell-crit-damage talent worth +100% at full rank, matching priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury (both WoW-accurate). Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.'

nodes.name: Misery
nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit by 1% per rank and your spell damage by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Your Shadow Word: Pain, Mind Flay and Vampiric Touch spells also increase the chance for harmful spells to hit by 1%/2%/3%.' DEPARTURE - the real talent is a DEBUFF on the target that helps the whole raid; a talent effect can never reach an ally and nothing applies a hit-chance debuff to an enemy. Delivered as the priest's own accuracy, with a small damage rider since the raid-wide half is lost. Kept from the outgoing tree, which was per-ability damage only.

nodes.name: Vampiric Touch
nodes.description: Teaches Vampiric Touch, a wound that feeds on the mind.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, kept - the ONLY unlock for priest_vampiric_touch, which is requires_talent. The real talent requires Shadowform, which connected_to reproduces. Moved from tier 4 to its real row. It is Dispersion's prerequisite, preserved below.

nodes.name: Pain and Suffering
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Shadow Word: Pain by 4% per rank, and your Mind Flay refreshes it.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, built with BOTH halves: 'Your Mind Flay has a 33%-100% chance to refresh the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain on the target, and reduces the damage done to you by your own Shadow Word: Death.' DEPARTURE on the mechanism - nothing can refresh an existing effect's duration from a proc, so cast_ability RE-CASTS Shadow Word: Pain instead, which refreshes it by re-applying it (a same-effect_id application refreshes duration, status_effects.py). cast_ability does NOT check that the caster learned the ability, and Shadow Word: Pain is baseline, so this is safe. Shadow Word: Death does not exist. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree, which had the damage half only.

nodes.name: Twisted Faith
nodes.description: Increases your spell power by 4% of your Spirit per rank and the damage of your Mind Flay and Mind Blast by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, built verbatim with both halves: 'Increases your spell power by 4%-20% of your total Spirit, and your damage done by your Mind Flay and Mind Blast is increased by 1%-5%.' A REAL stat conversion - spell_power is a valid target and spirit a valid source - and THE UNIT IS A RAW MULTIPLIER (character.py:1551: `gained = source * pct`), so 0.04 per rank reaches the real 20%. This is the payoff for Improved Spirit Tap at tier 0. The outgoing version granted FLAT spell_power and FLAT spirit, which is neither clause.

nodes.name: Dispersion
nodes.description: While badly wounded, you disperse into Shadow, taking 25% less damage.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10: 'You disperse into pure Shadow energy, reducing all damage taken by 90%. You are unable to attack or cast spells, but you regenerate 6% mana every second for 6 sec.' DEPARTURE - there is no ability to unlock and no way to forbid acting. Delivered as mitigation conditioned on being in trouble, which is when the real spell is used. low_health_damage_reduction_pct reads the ACTOR's own health and defaults to a 50% threshold, so low_health_threshold_pct is NOT authored. The real talent requires Vampiric Touch, reproduced. The outgoing version was a proc on Fade's duration.

nodes.name: Mind Sear
nodes.description: Teaches Mind Sear, searing the minds of everything around your target.
nodes._source: Kept - the ONLY unlock for priest_mind_sear, which is requires_talent. Mind Sear is a trained spell in real 3.3.5a rather than a talent, so this node is a Frontier addition; it stays because dropping it would strand the ability, and a second tier-6 node also gives the capstone row a choice rather than a single forced point.
